items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the relationship is established solely by the interviewer stating 'Olatunji and Amy was his wife' in reference to Babatunde Olatunji and John Coltrane.

ctx.x: Yeah and he had the school in Harlem when we used to go because Coltrane used to give donations for that place. Olatunji and Amy was his wife.
